title: ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. translated_title: ReFocus：面向长时程机器人操作强化学习的进度引导自适应练习
translated_abstract: 在线强化学习（RL）使视觉-语言-动作策略能够通过与环境的交互来不断改进。然而，在长时程操作任务中，稀疏的成功/失败反馈几乎无法提供策略在何处遇到瓶颈的信息。此外，反复进行完整任务的回合交互也使这些瓶颈得不到充分分析和针对性的练习。为此，我们提出了ReFocus，这是一种进度引导的多轮强化学习框架，它在全局RL与局部RL之间交替进行，以识别特定任务的瓶颈并为这些瓶颈分配额外的练习。具体而言，在全局RL阶段，我们将每个任务分解为子任务组成的有向无环图（DAG），然后利用基于DAG的进度奖励同时进行策略训练和瓶颈诊断。基于识别出的瓶颈，ReFocus选择自适应练习窗口，定义从入口阶段到目标阶段的任务片段，并为其分配额外的练习……
tldr: ReFocus提出了一种进度引导的多轮强化学习框架，通过将任务分解为有向无环图（DAG）并利用进度奖励诊断策略瓶颈，进而通过自适应练习窗口为瓶颈阶段分配针对性练习，以提升长时程机器人操作任务的RL性能。
en_tdlr: ReFocus is a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that decomposes tasks into a DAG of subtasks, uses DAG-based progress rewards to diagnose bottlenecks, and adaptively allocates extra practice to those bottleneck segments for long-horizon robotic manipulation.
